subject: Closure commitments and evidence delivery for critical findings (keystore / session / audit trail)
messages:
From: RedTeam Pentest <redteam@pentestco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security - Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test deliverable: prioritized findings + clarification items

Kimberly / Acme team,

Attached is the final consolidated penetration test report for the May engagement (pentest-report-20270515.pdf). We’ve prioritized findings by risk and included reproducible steps. High-priority items we recommend addressing first:

- H1: Keystore access via exposed API (requires rotation + scoped KMS permissions)
- H2: Short session token TTL and lack of refresh rotation for service accounts
- H3: Incomplete audit trail for admin privilege changes (missing immutable remote IP + actor id)

We have two quick clarification requests before we close our internal ticketing:
1) Did you scope any on-prem components (customer reported internal vault appliance) or was the assessment constrained to cloud-hosted inference nodes?
2) For the H1 finding, can you confirm whether the keystore is backed by a cloud KMS (and which provider) or a customer-managed HSM?

We can hold off final public report publication while you confirm remediation plans; otherwise we’ll publish the summary in two business days.

Attachments: pentest-report-20270515.pdf (PDF, 4.2MB)

Thanks,
Marcus Ruiz
Lead Consultant, RedTeam Pentest
redteam@pentestco.com

---
RedTeam Pentest -- Independent security testing and advisory
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: RedTeam Pentest <redteam@pentestco.com>
Cc: Acme Security - Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test deliverable: prioritized findings + clarification items

Marcus — thanks for the report and the clear priority list. We’ve queued an internal remediation sprint and I’m looping in our security lead (Irene) + ACME account owner (Monica) to coordinate the closure and evidence handoff. A few quick answers while we align the internal owners:

- Scope: the assessment was limited to hosted inference nodes and the control plane in our VPC regions; the Acme-managed on-prem vault was out-of-scope (per the engagement agreement).
- Keystore: production keystore is Redwood-managed and backed by AWS KMS; we do have a small set of customers on customer-managed HSMs but Acme is not one of them.

Irene — can you post a short remediation ETA table for H1-H3 and indicate what evidence we can provide to Acme (log exports, patch diffs, architecture diagram, signed keystore rotation record)?

Monica — please confirm whether Acme wants an interim remediation summary before we publish the public executive summary.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, RedTeam Pentest <redteam@pentestco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Acme Security - Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test deliverable: prioritized findings + clarification items

Hi all — quick remediation status and evidence plan. I’m the technical owner for the infra fixes; David is implementing code/ops changes and I’ll coordinate evidence collection. High-level ETA matrix below (I’ll attach artifacts to the shared Drive once they’re produced).

H1 - Keystore access (High)
- Root cause: overly permissive service role allowed DescribeKey + Decrypt on staging and one legacy prod agent.
- Fixes in flight: 1) Scoped KMS IAM policy push (completed in staging), 2) forced keystore principal rotation for impacted agent credentials (rotation job queued).
- ETA: scoped KMS policy applied to prod by 2027-05-18T18:00:00-07:00. Rotation complete and notarized by 2027-05-19T02:00:00-07:00.
- Evidence to provide: policy diff (remediation-patches-v1.tar.gz), signed rotation record (stored in Drive), KMS access logs export (audit-export-20270515.csv).

H2 - Session token TTL & service account refresh (Medium)
- Root cause: legacy service accounts issue with infinite refresh token chaining for telemetry agents.
- Fix: introduce 1h refresh window + forced reissue for impacted accounts; will add automated token rotation job to CI pipeline.
- ETA: code merged and staged by 2027-05-17T22:00:00-07:00; rollout to prod 2027-05-20T06:00:00-07:00 with post-deploy verification run.
- Evidence: CI run logs, rollout timeline, sample token expiry traces (will provide redacted traces).

H3 - Audit trail gaps for admin privilege escalations (Medium)
- Root cause: internal admin UI call path bypassed remote IP capture in the logging layer for older agents.
- Fix: add immutable event fields (actor_id, source_ip) to the admin change audit events; backfill missing fields where possible and add alerts for missing fields.
- ETA: logging schema change deployed to prod by 2027-05-22T04:00:00-07:00; backfill job estimated to complete by 2027-05-25T16:00:00-07:00.
- Evidence: schema diff, sample augmented audit records, backfill job report.

Notes:
- We will not expose raw hashes or private keys in the handoff. All artifacts will be redacted for customer consumption (signed rotation manifests are okay).
- RedTeam: please confirm whether your report requires us to include the staging remediation artifacts or only prod evidence. We’ll prioritize prod evidence unless you need staging artifacts for repro validation.

Attachments (to be uploaded): remediation-patches-v1.tar.gz, audit-export-20270515.csv

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

- Signed keystore rotation manifest (PDF)
- KMS access log slice (CSV) for the affected principals (redacted)
- Policy diff (human-readable) + patch tarball (remediation-patches-v1.tar.gz)

I’m running the rotation job now against the three impacted agents; I’ll post the Drive link to the artifacts when job completes (ETA ~ 2027-05-19T04:00:00-07:00). For immediate validation, I can provide a truncated KMS log snippet inline if you need to validate before the formal bundle.
